oracle_source: bzip2 manual (bzip2.1) and the upstream 1.0.8 fix for CVE-2019-12900
notes: A valid stream must decompress to the original bytes and exit 0.
A corrupt stream must be rejected with exit code 2 and no output.
The selector-overflow inputs must produce an out-of-bounds diagnostic in BZ2_decompress on the base version.
The correct patch must reject both selector-overflow inputs without a sanitizer finding.
The incomplete patch blocks the original selector count but not the alternate count.
The regression patch fixes the overflow but rejects valid block-size-9 streams.
